unifiedtaskoverview:
Special page name for [[Special:UnifiedTaskOverview]] special page.
{{Identical|My tasks}}
unifiedtaskoverview-label-no-task: Text that shows when the user does not have open tasks
unifiedtaskoverview-personal-url-my-task:
Label for the link in the personal urls that leads to the specialpage [[Special:UnifiedTaskOverview]].
{{Identical|Tasks}}
unifiedtaskoverview-no-login-text: Showed on Special:Userlogin when user tries to access their tasks before logging in
unifiedtaskoverview-filter-all: Label for the "All" option in the wiki filter widget on [[Special:UnifiedTaskOverview]].
unifiedtaskoverview-filter-wikis-section: Section label for wiki instance filter
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-title: Name of the <mytasks> tag, shown in the content droplet list and the tag inspector.
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-desc: Description of the <mytasks> tag, shown in the content droplet list.
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-empty: Shown by the <mytasks> tag if the user has no tasks.
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-anon: Shown by the <mytasks> tag to anonymous users.
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-error: Shown by the <mytasks> tag if the list of tasks could not be loaded.
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-column-page: Header of the column linking to the page a task belongs to, in the <mytasks> tag. {{Identical|Page}}
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-column-names: Header of the column showing the namespace of the page a task belongs to, in the <mytasks> tag. {{Identical|Namespace}}
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-column-descr: Header of the task description column of the <mytasks> tag. {{Identical|Description}}
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-column-insta: Header of the column showing the wiki a task originates from, in the <mytasks> tag. {{Identical|Wiki}}
unifiedtaskoverview-droplet-mytasks-task: Name of the droplet inserting the <mytasks> tag for tasks, shown in the content droplet list.
Description of the droplet inserting the <mytasks> tag for tasks.
unifiedtaskoverview-droplet-mytasks-read: Name of the droplet inserting the <mytasks> tag for read confirmations, shown in the content droplet list.
Description of the droplet inserting the <mytasks> tag for read confirmations.
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-attr-type-la: Label of the field choosing the type of task the <mytasks> tag lists, in the tag inspector. {{Identical|Type}}
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-type-task: Option of the type field of the <mytasks> tag: the tasks of SimpleTasks.
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-type-workflo: Option of the type field of the <mytasks> tag: the activities of Workflows.
unifiedtaskoverview-mytasks-type-readcon: Option of the type field of the <mytasks> tag: the read confirmations of PageReadConfirmations.
